blocks.text: Present Perfect Continuous — jarayon va uning izlari

Present Perfect Continuous (hozirgi tugallangan davomli zamon) — **have / has been + -ing**. Qizil kitobda u How long ...? bilan qisqacha tanishtirilgan (→ qizil kitob, 18-dars). Bu zamon ham o'tmishni hozirga bog'laydi (→ 7-dars), lekin diqqat **natijada** emas, **jarayonning o'zida**: harakat qancha davom etgani, uning hozir ko'rinib turgan izlari, takrorlanib kelayotgani. Ikki asosiy ma'nosi bor: 1) jarayon **hozirgina tugagan** va izi qolgan; 2) jarayon **hali davom etyapti** (how long, for, since).
Hozirgina tugagan jarayon: izlari ko'rinib turibdi

Hozirgi holatni (nafas qisishi, iflos qo'l, qizargan ko'z, charchoq, ho'l ko'cha) **yaqinda davom etgan jarayon** bilan tushuntirsak — Present Perfect Continuous. Jarayon endigina to'xtagan yoki hozir ham bir oz davom etayotgan bo'lishi mumkin; muhimi — uning **izlari** bor. O'zbekchada bunday gaplar ko'pincha «**-di**» yoki «**-yotgan edi**» bilan aytiladi: Sochlaring ho'l — **suzdingmi**? Shuning uchun o'zbek o'quvchi bu yerda Past Simple ishlatib yuboradi.

items.text: Your hair is wet. **Have** you **been swimming**?
I**'ve been cleaning** the flat all morning, so I'm exhausted.
Sorry about the mess — we**'ve been decorating** the living room.

blocks.text: Hali davom etayotgan jarayon: how long, for, since

Jarayon o'tmishda boshlangan va **hozir ham davom etyapti** — buni «qancha vaqtdan beri» bilan aytsak, Present Perfect Continuous kerak. O'zbekchada esa hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi: «Ikki soatdan beri yomg'ir **yog'yapti**» → It**'s been raining** for two hours. «It's raining for two hours» ✗ — davomiylik qo'shildimi, Present Continuous endi yaramaydi. for va since farqi → 12-dars, How long ...? → 11-dars.

rows: It**'s been raining** for two hours.
I**'ve been waiting** for you since this morning.
Why are your hands dirty? — I**'ve been repairing** the car.
**Have** you **been crying**? Your eyes are red.

items.text: The neighbours' dog **has been barking** for an hour.

blocks.text: Bir davr davomida qayta-qayta bo'lib kelayotgan harakatlar ham shu zamonda: She**'s been playing** tennis since she was eight — sakkiz yoshidan beri (muntazam) tennis o'ynaydi. Bu yerda bitta uzluksiz jarayon emas, balki **takrorlar zanjiri** — lekin u ham o'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etyapti. O'zbekchada: «...-dan beri **qatnaydi / o'ynaydi / qo'ng'iroq qiladi**».

items.text: Jasur **has been going** to Arabic classes twice a week since autumn.
items.translation: Jasur kuzdan beri haftasiga ikki marta arab tili darslariga **qatnayapti**.

items.text: Someone **has been using** my mug — it's never where I leave it.
items.translation: Kimdir krujkamdan **foydalanib yuribdi** — u hech qachon men qo'ygan joyda bo'lmaydi.

blocks.text: I'm doing va I've been doing; holat fe'llari

Davomiylik aytilmasa — Present Continuous: I**'m learning** to drive. Davomiylik (how long, for, since, all day) qo'shilsa — Present Perfect Continuous: I**'ve been learning** to drive for three months. Holat fe'llari (know, have = ega, believe, want, be — → 4-dars) Continuous olmaydi, ular bilan **have + V3** ishlatiladi: I**'ve known** her for years («I've been knowing» ✗), We**'ve had** this car since 2018.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I am waiting for you for an hour.» → I**'ve been waiting** for you for an hour.; «I'm living here since 2020.» → I**'ve been living** (yoki I**'ve lived**) here since 2020.; «I have been knowing her for years.» → I**'ve known** her for years.; «She has been work all day.» → She has been **working** all day.; «How long are you learning English?» → How long **have** you **been learning** English?; izi ko'rinib turgan jarayon uchun «Did you cry?» → **Have** you **been crying**?

O'zbekchada «**-dan beri**» + «-yapman / -yapti» eshitsangiz — inglizchada deyarli doim **have been + -ing** (holat fe'li bo'lsa — have + V3). «Hozir» bor-u, «qancha vaqtdan beri» yo'q bo'lsa — oddiy Present Continuous yetadi.

have been doing va have done farqi (jarayon va natija) → 10-dars; How long ...? va am / have been → 11-dars; for va since → 12-dars; o'tmishdagi bir paytgacha davom etgan jarayon (I **had been waiting** for an hour when ...) → 16-dars.

rows: Your eyes are red. **Have** you **been crying**?
It**'s been raining** for two hours.
She**'s been playing** tennis since she was eight.

examples.title: Visible evidence: **Have** you **been running**?
examples.description: Hozirgina tugagan yoki endigina to'xtagan jarayon va uning hozir ko'rinib turgan izlari: nafas qisishi, iflos qo'l, qizargan ko'z, ho'l ko'cha.

sentences.text: You're out of breath — **have** you **been running**?
sentences.translation: Nafasing tiqilib qolibdi — **yugurdingmi**?

sentences.text: Why are your hands so dirty? — I**'ve been fixing** my bike.
sentences.translation: Qo'llaring nega bunchalik iflos? — Velosipedimni **tuzatayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: Madina's eyes are red. I think she**'s been crying**.
sentences.translation: Madinaning ko'zlari qizarib ketibdi. Menimcha, u **yig'lagan**.

sentences.text: The streets are all wet. **Has** it **been raining**?
sentences.translation: Ko'chalar ho'l bo'lib ketibdi. Yomg'ir **yog'dimi**?

sentences.text: Sorry I'm so dirty — I**'ve been working** in the garden all afternoon.
sentences.translation: Bunchalik iflosligim uchun uzr — tushdan keyin bo'yi bog'da **ishladim**.

sentences.text: Bekzod looks exhausted because he**'s been studying** for his exams all night.
sentences.translation: Bekzod juda charchagan ko'rinadi, chunki tun bo'yi imtihonlarga **tayyorlandi**.

sentences.text: There's paint on your shirt. What **have** you **been doing**?
sentences.translation: Ko'ylagingda bo'yoq bor. Nima **qilayotgan eding**?

sentences.text: The kitchen smells wonderful — **have** you **been baking**?
sentences.translation: Oshxonadan ajoyib hid kelyapti — **pishiriq pishirdingmi**?

sentences.text: My back hurts because I**'ve been sitting** at the computer for too long.
sentences.translation: Belim og'riyapti, chunki kompyuter oldida juda uzoq **o'tirib qoldim**.

sentences.text: Emma's voice is hoarse — she**'s been shouting** at the football match.
sentences.translation: Emmaning ovozi xirillab qolibdi — futbol o'yinida **baqirgan**.

examples.title: Explaining a situation: I**'ve been working** hard
examples.description: Hozirgi holatni (charchoq, o'zgarish, muammo) yaqinda davom etgan jarayon bilan tushuntirish. Diqqat jarayonning o'zida, natijada emas.

sentences.text: I'm sorry I haven't called — I**'ve been working** really long hours.
sentences.translation: Qo'ng'iroq qilmaganim uchun uzr — so'nggi paytlarda juda ko'p **ishlayapman**.

sentences.text: Jasur is very tanned because he**'s been travelling** around Spain.
sentences.translation: Jasur ancha qorayib qolibdi, chunki Ispaniya bo'ylab **sayohat qilib yurgan**.

sentences.text: Our electricity bill is huge — the kids **have been playing** computer games day and night.
sentences.translation: Elektr uchun to'lovimiz juda katta — bolalar kechayu kunduz kompyuter o'yinlari **o'ynashyapti**.

sentences.text: Sarah is feeling much better because she**'s been taking** the new medicine.
sentences.translation: Sara o'zini ancha yaxshi his qilyapti, chunki yangi dorini **ichib yuribdi**.

sentences.text: The phone battery is dead — **have** you **been watching** videos again?
sentences.translation: Telefon batareyasi o'tirib qolibdi — yana video **ko'rdingmi**?

sentences.text: Your English is so much better! **Have** you **been practising** with someone?
sentences.translation: Ingliz tiling ancha yaxshilanibdi! Kim bilandir **mashq qilyapsanmi**?

sentences.text: Aziz knows a lot about the case because he**'s been following** it in the news.
sentences.translation: Aziz bu ish haqida ko'p narsa biladi, chunki uni yangiliklarda **kuzatib boryapti**.

sentences.text: Prices are confusing at the moment because the shop **has been changing** them every week.
sentences.translation: Hozir narxlar chalkash, chunki do'kon ularni har hafta **o'zgartirib turibdi**.

sentences.text: I can't sleep at night because the neighbours **have been building** an extension.
sentences.translation: Kechalari uxlay olmayapman, chunki qo'shnilar uyga qo'shimcha xona **qurishyapti**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has a sore throat because she**'s been teaching** six lessons a day.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning tomog'i og'riyapti, chunki kuniga oltita dars **o'tib kelyapti**.

examples.title: Still in progress: **for** two hours, **since** Monday
examples.description: O'tmishda boshlanib, hozir ham davom etayotgan jarayon — for (muddat) va since (boshlanish nuqtasi) bilan. O'zbekchada «-dan beri ... -yapti».

sentences.text: It**'s been snowing** since early morning, and the mountain roads are closed.
sentences.translation: Erta tongdan beri qor **yog'yapti**, tog' yo'llari yopilgan.

sentences.text: I**'ve been waiting** for the plumber since nine o'clock.
sentences.translation: Soat to'qqizdan beri santexnikni **kutyapman**.

sentences.text: We**'ve been living** in this flat for six months, and we still haven't met the neighbours.
sentences.translation: Olti oydan beri bu kvartirada **yashayapmiz**, lekin hali qo'shnilar bilan tanishmadik.

sentences.text: Tom **has been learning** Uzbek for a year, so he can already read the menu.
sentences.translation: Tom bir yildan beri o'zbek tilini **o'rganyapti**, shuning uchun menyuni o'qiy oladi.

sentences.text: The baby **has been crying** for half an hour — maybe she's hungry.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq yarim soatdan beri **yig'layapti** — balki qorni ochdir.

sentences.text: Madina **has been working** on her thesis since September.
sentences.translation: Madina sentyabrdan beri dissertatsiyasi ustida **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: You**'ve been talking** on the phone for ages — who is it?
sentences.translation: Ancha vaqtdan beri telefonda **gaplashyapsan** — kim u?

sentences.text: Engineers **have been repairing** the bridge since March, and it's still not open.
sentences.translation: Muhandislar martdan beri ko'prikni **ta'mirlashyapti**, u esa hali ham ochilmadi.

sentences.text: My computer **has been making** a strange noise for a few days.
sentences.translation: Bir necha kundan beri kompyuterim g'alati ovoz **chiqaryapti**.

sentences.text: Oliver **has been looking** for a flat in central London since he got the job.
sentences.translation: Oliver ishga kirganidan beri Londonning markazidan kvartira **qidiryapti**.

examples.title: Repeated actions: **have been going**, **have been playing**
examples.description: Bir davr davomida takrorlanib kelayotgan harakatlar: since she was eight, regularly, every Sunday. O'zbekchada «...-dan beri qatnaydi / o'ynaydi».

sentences.text: Kate **has been playing** tennis since she was eight.
sentences.translation: Keyt sakkiz yoshidan beri tennis **o'ynaydi**.

sentences.text: I**'ve been going** to the gym three times a week, and I feel great.
sentences.translation: Haftasiga uch marta sport zaliga **qatnayapman**, o'zimni ajoyib his qilyapman.

sentences.text: Someone **has been leaving** rubbish outside our door every night.
sentences.translation: Kimdir har kecha eshigimiz oldiga axlat **tashlab ketyapti**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has been phoning** his grandmother every Sunday since she moved to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bekzod buvisi Buxoroga ko'chib ketganidan beri har yakshanba unga **qo'ng'iroq qiladi**.

sentences.text: We**'ve been having** problems with the internet all week.
sentences.translation: Butun hafta internet bilan **muammolarimiz bo'lyapti**.

sentences.text: The postman **has been delivering** our letters to the wrong address for months.
sentences.translation: Pochtachi bir necha oydan beri xatlarimizni noto'g'ri manzilga **yetkazyapti**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **has been cycling** to work since the metro became so crowded.
sentences.translation: Metro tiqilinch bo'lib qolganidan beri Nilufar ishga velosipedda **qatnayapti**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **been taking** your vitamins regularly, as the doctor said?
sentences.translation: Shifokor aytganidek, vitaminlaringni muntazam **ichib yuribsanmi**?

sentences.text: James **has been writing** a blog about Uzbek food for three years.
sentences.translation: Jeyms uch yildan beri o'zbek taomlari haqida blog **yuritadi**.

sentences.text: Lately my brother **has been coming** home very late, and Mum is worried.
sentences.translation: So'nggi paytlarda akam uyga juda kech **kelyapti**, oyim xavotirda.

examples.title: How long **have** you **been** ...**ing**?
examples.description: Qancha vaqtdan beri? — How long + have / has + ega + been + -ing? Javobda for / since. Batafsil → 11-dars.

sentences.text: How long **have** you **been learning** the piano? — Since I was six.
sentences.translation: Qancha vaqtdan beri pianino chalishni **o'rganyapsiz**? — Olti yoshimdan beri.

sentences.text: How long **has** Aziz **been working** at the embassy? — About two years.
sentences.translation: Aziz elchixonada qancha vaqtdan beri **ishlayapti**? — Ikki yilcha.

sentences.text: So how long **have** they **been building** that shopping centre? It feels like forever.
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, o'sha savdo markazini qancha vaqtdan beri **qurishyapti**? Abadiy davom etayotganga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: Do you know how long the patient **has been waiting** for the operation?
sentences.translation: Bemor operatsiyani qancha vaqtdan beri **kutayotganini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: We**'ve been driving** for five hours — can we stop for a break?
sentences.translation: Besh soatdan beri **mashina haydayapmiz** — dam olish uchun to'xtasak bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: **Have** you **been waiting** long? — No, only a couple of minutes.
sentences.translation: Ko'pdan beri **kutyapsizmi**? — Yo'q, bor-yo'g'i bir-ikki daqiqa.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **hasn't been feeling** well for a few days, so she's staying at home.
sentences.translation: Bir necha kundan beri Dilnoza o'zini yaxshi **his qilmayapti**, shuning uchun uyda qolyapti.

sentences.text: Exactly how long **has** the water **been leaking** from the ceiling?
sentences.translation: Shiftdan suv aniq qancha vaqtdan beri **oqyapti**?

sentences.text: Tell me, how long **have** you two **been going** out together?
sentences.translation: Ayt-chi, ikkovingiz qancha vaqtdan beri **uchrashib yuribsizlar**?

sentences.text: James **has been teaching** English in Fergana for almost a decade.
sentences.translation: Jeyms qariyb o'n yildan beri Farg'onada ingliz tilidan **dars beradi**.

examples.title: Questions and negatives: **haven't been sleeping**
examples.description: Inkor — haven't / hasn't been + -ing; so'roq — Have / Has + ega + been + -ing? What have you been doing? — «Nima qilib yuribsan?»

sentences.text: I **haven't been sleeping** well lately, so I've stopped drinking coffee.
sentences.translation: So'nggi paytlarda yaxshi **uxlay olmayapman**, shuning uchun qahva ichishni tashladim.

sentences.text: What **have** you **been doing** since we last met? — Mostly working and travelling.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi uchrashganimizdan beri nima **qilib yuribsan**? — Asosan ishlab, sayohat qilib.

sentences.text: **Has** Oliver **been behaving** himself at school? — Not really.
sentences.translation: Oliver maktabda o'zini yaxshi **tutyaptimi**? — Unchalik emas.

sentences.text: We **haven't been using** the car much since we moved closer to the centre.
sentences.translation: Markazga yaqinroq ko'chib o'tganimizdan beri mashinadan deyarli **foydalanmayapmiz**.

sentences.text: Who **has been eating** my biscuits? The packet is almost empty!
sentences.translation: Pechenyelarimni kim **yeyapti**? Paket deyarli bo'sh-ku!

sentences.text: Sarah **hasn't been answering** her phone all day — I'm getting worried.
sentences.translation: Sara kun bo'yi telefonini **ko'tarmayapti** — xavotirlana boshladim.

sentences.text: **Have** you **been following** the elections in Britain?
sentences.translation: Britaniyadagi saylovlarni **kuzatib boryapsizmi**?

sentences.text: Why **haven't** you **been coming** to the English club recently?
sentences.translation: Nega so'nggi paytlarda ingliz tili klubiga **kelmayapsiz**?

sentences.text: The company **hasn't been doing** very well this year, so there are no bonuses.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyaning bu yil ishlari unchalik yaxshi **ketmayapti**, shuning uchun mukofot yo'q.

sentences.text: Where **have** you **been hiding**? Nobody has seen you for weeks!
sentences.translation: Qayerlarda **bekinib yuribsan**? Bir necha haftadan beri seni hech kim ko'rmadi!

examples.title: **is waiting** / **has been waiting**; state verbs
examples.description: Davomiylik aytilmasa — Present Continuous, aytilsa — Present Perfect Continuous. Holat fe'llari Continuous olmaydi: I've known, they've had, she's wanted.

sentences.text: Aziz **is learning** Chinese. He**'s been learning** it for two years.
sentences.translation: Aziz xitoy tilini **o'rganyapti**. Uni ikki yildan beri **o'rganyapti**.

sentences.text: Oh no, it**'s raining** in Manchester again — it**'s been raining** on and off since we arrived.
sentences.translation: Voy, Manchesterda yana yomg'ir **yog'yapti** — biz kelganimizdan beri goh yog'ib, goh to'xtab **turibdi**.

sentences.text: Look, Madina **is waiting** for you. She**'s been waiting** since six!
sentences.translation: Qara, Madina seni **kutyapti**. U soat oltidan beri **kutyapti**!

sentences.text: I **know** Bekzod well — I**'ve known** him since primary school.
sentences.translation: Bekzodni yaxshi **bilaman** — uni boshlang'ich maktabdan beri **taniyman**.

sentences.text: My parents **have** a dacha near Chimgan, and they**'ve had** it since the nineties.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning Chimyon yaqinida dala hovlisi **bor**, u to'qsoninchi yillardan beri ularda **bor**.

sentences.text: Tom **is staying** with us at the moment — he**'s been staying** here since Friday.
sentences.translation: Tom hozir biznikida **turibdi** — jumadan beri shu yerda **turibdi**.

sentences.text: Emma **has wanted** to be a doctor since she was a little girl.
sentences.translation: Emma kichkinaligidan beri shifokor bo'lishni **xohlaydi**.

sentences.text: Why **are** you **laughing**? You**'ve been laughing** for five minutes!
sentences.translation: Nega **kulyapsan**? Besh daqiqadan beri **kulyapsan**!

sentences.text: Jasur **has been** ill since Monday, so he's missed three lectures.
sentences.translation: Jasur dushanbadan beri **kasal**, shuning uchun uchta ma'ruzani o'tkazib yubordi.

sentences.text: The workers **are striking** for better pay; they**'ve been striking** for over a month now.
sentences.translation: Ishchilar yuqoriroq maosh talab qilib **ish tashlashyapti**; ular bir oydan ortiq vaqtdan beri **ish tashlab turibdi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: catching up with an old friend
examples.description: Eski do'stlar uchrashuvi: so'nggi paytlarda nima bilan band bo'lganlari — have been doing savollar va javoblar.

sentences.text: — Kate! I haven't seen you for ages. What **have** you **been doing**?
sentences.translation: — Keyt! Seni ko'rmaganimga ancha bo'ldi. Nima **qilib yuribsan**?

sentences.text: — Oh, lots of things! I**'ve been working** for a start-up in Manchester.
sentences.translation: — Oh, ko'p narsa! Manchesterdagi bir startapda **ishlayapman**.

sentences.text: — Really? How long **have** you **been doing** that?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Qancha vaqtdan beri **ishlayapsan**?

sentences.text: — Since January. And I**'ve been studying** Uzbek in the evenings, believe it or not!
sentences.translation: — Yanvardan beri. Ishonsang-ishonma, kechqurunlari o'zbek tilini ham **o'rganyapman**!

sentences.text: — That's amazing! So that's why you**'ve been sending** me messages in Uzbek.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r-ku! Shuning uchun menga o'zbekcha xabarlar **yuboryapsan** ekan-da.

sentences.text: — Exactly. What about you, Aziz? You look tired — **have** you **been sleeping** properly?
sentences.translation: — Xuddi shunday. O'zing-chi, Aziz? Charchaganga o'xshaysan — yaxshi **uxlayapsanmi**?

sentences.text: — Not really. Our baby **has been waking** us up three times a night.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. Chaqalog'imiz bizni kechasi uch marta **uyg'otyapti**.

sentences.text: — Poor you! And **have** you **been going** to your football games on Saturdays?
sentences.translation: — Bechora! Shanba kunlari futbolga **qatnab turibsanmi**?

sentences.text: — No, I **haven't been playing** since the baby was born.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, chaqaloq tug'ilganidan beri **o'ynamayapman**.

sentences.text: — Well, I**'ve been looking** for a reason to visit you — let's meet this weekend!
sentences.translation: — Unda, men ham senikiga borishga bahona **qidirib yurgandim** — shu dam olish kunlari uchrashaylik!
